notes: Labels print without colons. A text block directly before a table is that table's printed heading: Quality Objectives, Quality Roles and Responsibilities, and Deliverables and Processes Subject to Quality Review each print as a label above a two-column box, not as a header cell inside it. Quality Objectives prints four numbered rows ('1.' to '4.' in both cells); Quality Roles and Responsibilities prints three numbered rows ('1.' to '3.'); Deliverables and Processes is one tall blank row. Page 2 has the title bar but no Project Title / Date Prepared line. The prose (Table 2.21) names the same elements in sentence case.
